svg.title: Environmental inspector — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as environmental inspector, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A capped environmental sample bottle stands beside a separate long-handled field scoop above a soil line. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
